hypothesis: An inversion-free exact squarefree test confines inversions to smaller repeated-factor branches and can avoid unnecessary nilpotency work without losing any roots.

experiments.test: Exhaust small binary-field quintics with literal factor-division and multiplicity oracles; verify Delta squarefree equivalence, quadratic and cubic branch reconstruction.
Freeze full-width binary field cases, including GF2^83, squarefree/repeated/zero controls; calibrate cold total costs against original nilpotency and factor recovery.

falsifier: Any lost repeated/zero branch or no total arithmetic benefit after inverse/dispatch/setup costs. Keep old predicate when faster.
